PASS on the fake backend only (evidence contract_checked, never an MHS-Device level). Model-authored and unreviewed: driver.lock.json authored_by is a model, reviewed_by is null; no human reviewed or tested anything, no hardware was attached, and no hardware, ROS or Gazebo run is claimed. DEVIATION FROM THE CARD: the card names helper RosDriver and family ros, but the confirmed entry symbol gym_gazebo.envs.turtlebot:GazeboCircuitTurtlebotLidarEnv is a legacy gym.Env whose public interface is reset() and step(action); the ROS 1 velocity publisher and the Gazebo pause/reset services are internals created by its constructor, not a rosbridge endpoint surface a RosDriver could drive. This package uses GymnasiumDriver over cap.world.step.v1, cap.world.reset.v1 and cap.world.seed.v1, preserving the environment step/reset interface; the bridge has explicit fallbacks for legacy gym's four-value step result and argument-less reset. SERVED SCOPE: only GazeboCircuitTurtlebotLidarEnv / GazeboCircuitTurtlebotLidar-v0; the card's other four entry symbols are separate environments and are not covered. The action space is the upstream spaces.Discrete(3) (#F,L,R) at gym_gazebo/envs/turtlebot/gazebo_circuit_turtlebot_lidar.py:26, cited by action_space_ref, so the bridge derives action.index 0..2 with source upstream_code; the driver declares no Limit, no bound is operator_required, and no site-limits.example.json is needed. BACKEND FACTORY: only backends['fake'] = .fake:FakeGazeboCircuitTurtlebotLidarEnv exists. The pinned class starts roslaunch (gym_gazebo/envs/gazebo_env.py:53) and requires ROS Melodic and Gazebo 9 (INSTALL.md:13-15) plus legacy gym (setup.py:10); package code never imports the clone and that live path was not run, so there is no sim or hardware backend. FAKE: analytic F0 stand-in, not a recording; engine analytic:gym-gazebo GazeboCircuitTurtlebotLidar-v0 fake (no Gazebo), timestep 0 ms, realtime_factor 0, lockstep clock, full reset, no snapshot/restore. The five sector distances and per-tick closings are placeholders; the fake checks and samples the same five placeholder sectors while upstream checks every beam; it models no Twist, pose, velocity, collision geometry, physics, raycast or ROS timing, has no rendering, and reset(seed=...) is a fake extension because upstream reset() takes no seed. The observation is the same five-value discretized list the upstream discretize_observation(data, 5) returns, so no observation array is reduced; NOT COVERED: the upstream Gazebo simulator and the raw LaserScan stream. SAFETY: simulated R0 because the effects are confined to simulated state; the runtime software e-stop latch is the only stop, the manifest declares no native stop, and no physical e-stop or hardware safety is claimed (this is a simulation of a mobile base, with no hardware backend). WARNINGS: the expected G6.NO_NATIVE_CALL for cap.world.seed.v1 (it stores the pending seed for the next reset and makes no native call) and four G8.NO_UNIT for the bridge-derived integer inputs (reset seed, seed seed, action.index and ticks); no G4.REF_VALUE or G4.REF_BINARY warning was raised. TESTS: test_driver.py keeps check_driver(HERE, backend='fake') and adds eight cases (derived discrete limit, reset shape, forward step, envelope refusal, terminal step and reset, pending seed, e-stop latch and safety reset, manifest fidelity); they pass. gate.digest is the digest line of the last CLI gate run; check-report.json is regenerated by every gate run and is not part of the package. No catalogue extension ids are used, so there are no catalogue_requests.

MODEL REVIEW (claude-opus-5-5, a model and not a human, 2026-11-05; reviewed_by stays null): Checked the GymnasiumDriver deviation, all 19 facts, action_space_ref (gazebo_circuit_turtlebot_lidar.py:26), the five card entry symbols, the fake and the stop text against gazebo_env.py, the TurtleBot environments, gym_gazebo/__init__.py and the environment's launch file at the pin. The deviation is right (GazeboCircuitTurtlebotLidarEnv is a legacy gym.Env whose Twist publisher and Gazebo services are internal), the fake follows the upstream discretization, action meanings, rewards and (ranges, done) reset result, and the other four entry symbols are separate Gazebo TurtleBot environments with no hardware path. Defects: safe_state said the simulation stops advancing, although the latch sends nothing and upstream Gazebo stays paused only because each step and reset ends with an unchecked /gazebo/pause_physics call whose failure is only printed; the scan fact hid that a step retries the 5 s wait without limit inside a bare except; the README fact named a TurtleBot the line does not; and the live-construction hazards (os.environ rewritten, standard output printed, roslaunch and rospy.init_node in the server process, killall -9 of every gzclient, gzserver, rosmaster and roscore in _close) and the swallowed service failures were not disclosed. Reviewer changed driver.py (safe_state, three facts corrected, five source facts added, three fidelity gaps), test_driver.py (the seed case is labelled fake-only because the upstream reset takes no seed) and facts.md, and regenerated reference.json, REFERENCE.md and check-report.json. The gate and collect.py --strict pass with the expected G6.NO_NATIVE_CALL and G8.NO_UNIT warnings and the digest unchanged. For the human reviewer: Fake-only contract; no sim backend is declared and the repository has no hardware path. A live construction in the MHS server process would rewrite ROS_MASTER_URI and GAZEBO_MASTER_URI in the process environment, print to standard output, start roslaunch (Gazebo plus the turtlebot_gazebo kobuki base; GYM_GAZEBO_WORLD_CIRCUIT must be set), call rospy.init_node in the server process, wait for services without timeouts and retry the /scan wait forever; the legacy GazeboEnv._close runs killall -9 on every gzclient, gzserver, rosmaster and roscore of the host, unrelated ones included. Upstream Gazebo is paused after each completed step or reset only by an unchecked pause call; the latch sends nothing, so after a failed pause or another client's unpause the simulated TurtleBot drives on with the last Twist. The existing override still names family ros and five entry symbols; the proposal keeps only the served one.
